I am an old Sukuma farmer with many hectares and cattle, so I put manure on this plot when my sons can carry it from the kraal. I managed to buy a little bag of fertilizer from the agro-dealer because the village extension man said it helps the soil, but I do not have cash for chemicals or improved seed, so I use seed I kept from last season. This plot is too big for my family alone, so I will hire some young men from the village to help with the heavy weeding and harvest, but we must wait for the rains because there is no river or pump here.
